nature: PROSPECTIVE held-out cohort (seed 20261025, 150 queries, fresh data, V19 templates). Generated from the seed and frozen by git blob SHA before any Spark, Coq or SQLite execution of these queries.
question: Do certificates for the top V20 trace blockers (transitive IFFC inference, ReplaceDistinctWithAggregate, EliminateOuterJoin) raise whole-trace coverage on unseen queries without any loss of safety?
checker: QueryProofTrace2.v over QueryProofDeepWide2.v (copies; V19/V20 stay frozen): implication adds transport of an old conjunct along an old strict x = y; EliminateOuterJoin rule; project-transparent side form also offers the old inner filter as an old conjunct when its columns are projected. check3_sound, check4_sound, trace_sound closed under the global context.
unit_trace: all effective events of the logical optimizer executor after Finish Analysis, for one query, with tag names before and after each event

definitions.CERTIFIED trace: kernel-checked Example trace_ok ok_tag evs = true
definitions.trace mutant: drop_middle_event, swap_adjacent_events, unknown_tag, splice_<family> (a corrupted rewrite spliced in with connectivity preserved). Each violates a trace_ok condition by construction; accepting one is a safety failure
definitions.endpoint differential: the V19 SQLite differential on (first plan, last plan) of each certified trace
definitions.full_trace_coverage: certified non-empty traces / queries with at least one suffix event (UNKNOWN and rejected traces in the denominator)

T0a_no_certified_trace_differs.statement: No certified trace's endpoints differ (or are ill-scoped) in SQLite.

T0b_endpoint_evaluable_fraction.statement: At least 80% of certified traces are evaluable by the differential.

T1b_trace_mutant_power.statement: At least 100 trace mutants are evaluated.

E1_no_invalid_event_mutant_accepted.statement: Per event (check4): no VALIDATED_WRONG or ILL_SCOPED mutant accepted.

E1b_event_mutant_power.statement: At least 150 per-event mutants are VALIDATED_WRONG.

T2_connected_observation.statement: 0 JSON connectivity breaks and 0 kernel link failures between consecutive observed events.

T3_contract_coverage.statement: No observed tag outside the contract, no ANSI-off query, no tag-observer UNKNOWN line.

T4_full_trace_coverage.statement: At least 65% of queries with suffix events have their whole logical-optimizer trace certified (V20 cohort: 0.544).

H5_oracle_agreement.statement: Spark and SQLite query result bags agree on every query both engines execute.

reported_without_prediction: first failing rule per uncertified trace
exact SQL overlap with the V17-V20 cohorts
reporting: All counts are reported whether or not thresholds are met. Failures and infrastructure reruns stay on record.
